question: Which team became the first Indian sports team to unveil an official team logo in the metaverse in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat Titans.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__****Gujarat Titans**

__
 
• Franchise for cricket Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India is the location of **Gujarat Titans.**
 
• The Titans are a group in the** Indian Premier League (IPL).**
 
• The **Narendra Modi Stadium, **located in Motera, became the **home field **of the **Gujarat Titans **in **2021**.
 
• **CVC Capital Partners** is the franchise's **owner**.
 
• The team's **captain **is **Hardik Pandya**, and **Ashish Nehra **is the team's **coach**.
 
• The current IPL champions are the Gujarat Titans, who claimed their **first title** during the **2022 **campaign.
 
• In the **Metaverse**, Gujarat Titans (GT) unveiled their **official logo.**
 
• Being the first Indian sports team to do so, GT has made **history **by adding its team logo to the Metaverse.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__****Delhi Capitals:**

 
• **Delhi **is home to Delhi Capitals (formerly known as the Delhi Daredevils), a franchise cricket team in the **Indian Premier League (IPL).**
 
• A share of the franchise is under the management of both **GMR **and **JSW Group**.
 
• The team plays home games at New Delhi's **Arun Jaitley Stadium.**
 
• The team's **captain **is** ****Rishabh Pant**, and **Ricky **Ponting is the team's **coach**.**​**

**Mumbai Indians: **

 
• With **five championships**, the Mumbai Indians are the Indian Premier League's most **successful team**.
 
• They represent a cricket franchise with their main office in **Mumbai, Maharashtra.**
 
• **Reliance Industries,** the largest corporation in India, controls 100% of its 100% subsidiary IndiaWin Sports, which was founded in **2008**.

**Chennai Super Kings:**

 
• **​**Based in **Chennai**, **Tamil Nadu**, the Chennai Super Kings (CSK) is a cricket team that participates in the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• The **M. A. Chidambaram Stadium** in Chennai serves as the home field for the 2008-founded squad.
 
• The team is owned by** India Cement Limited** through the holding firm Chennai Super Kings Cricket Limited.
